verdict.rationale: GitBook has a dedicated 'AI insights' analytics page (gitbook-docs-21) alongside general 'Analytics & user feedback' (gitbook-docs-12), suggesting some analytics view focused on AI-related activity, but no evidence details whether it actually separates AI-agent/bot traffic from human readers in the dashboard.
